artworks.title: C'est demain la fête de sa femme
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking on a cobblestone street. He is carrying a bouquet and several potted plants. The man is depicted with detailed facial features, wearing a top hat, dark jacket, vest, striped pants, and shoes. He is holding a walking stick. In the background, other men in overcoats and top hats are walking together. A building with windows is visible, casting shadows. The image is done in a classic monochromatic illustration style.

artworks.title: Mossieu Rabourdeau ...  je ne parlerai plus politique avec vous ..
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting on a bench. Both men are upright and facing each other. The man on the left appears concerned or surprised, with wide eyes, a pointed nose, and a small chin. He wears a bowler hat and a dark coat. The man on the right has a more sagacious expression, with a long face, a longer nose, and a pronounced chin. He wears a top hat and a dark coat. Both men hold canes. The background includes sketched tree trunks and part of a stone structure.

artworks.title: Ouverture de la chasse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene. The image shows a deer jumping over a person who is startled and on the ground. Trees and a natural environment are in the background. The style is reminiscent of caricature, with expressive lines emphasizing action and expressions.

artworks.title: A Haiti
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures. One figure is in a dynamic pose, wearing a flamboyant outfit with a tall feathered hat and holding a rifle. The figure is gesturing towards the second figure who is standing stiffly, holding a cane and dressed in traditional attire. The second figure appears surprised. In the background, there is a simplified building or structure, foliage, and landscape elements. The drawing is done in pencil with bold lines capturing the characters' expressions and actions.

artworks.title: Emigration
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a dog leading a group of animals across a border. The focal point is a dog walking on its hind legs, carrying a stick with a tied bundle over its shoulder. The dog is crossing past a wooden sign that reads "Frontière," indicating a border. Following the lead dog are various animals, including pigs, all moving in the same direction. The landscape includes a few rocks and suggests a rural setting. The style appears to be a satirical or political cartoon using humor and metaphor to make a commentary, possibly on topics such as migration or borders.

artworks.title: Vous voila maintenant passe citoyen
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In this image, two people are depicted from the waist up, sitting next to each other. The man on the left is seated on a chair, leaning slightly forward, and holding a dog in his arms. He has short, dark hair and appears to be smiling while looking directly at the dog. He is wearing a dark suit and a white shirt. The woman on the right is also seated on a chair, leaning slightly back. She has her hair pulled back and is wearing a bonnet, a dress with a high collar, and a patterned shawl. Her hands are resting in her lap. Both individuals are in a domestic setting, with lined wallpaper or paneling in the background.

artworks.title: Courses nautiques de 1856
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a horse race scene with spectators holding umbrellas. In the background, there are horses and jockeys racing. The foreground shows the spectators watching the event under umbrellas during a rainstorm. The drawing is in a style reminiscent of satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: Aspect de Paris, depuis qu'on a joue...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with floating hats that have labels related to financial markets. The scene shows a street in Paris with balconies. On one balcony, a person is looking at the street below where many hats are floating in the air. Each hat is labeled with terms such as "cotton," "café," and "blé." The sketch style suggests a satirical approach to the scene. The words "Actualités" and "Aspect de Paris, depuis qu'on a joué la fameuse comédie morale intitulée LA BOURSE" hint at a critique or reflection on societal behaviors linked to the stock exchange or trading practices.

artworks.title: Un animal rempli de modestie...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched illustration of a man in a kitchen setting. The man is standing to the right, wearing a beret, a beard, and a chef's uniform with an apron. He is holding a rope connected to an animal that is partially visible to the left. In the background, there are kitchen utensils hanging on the wall, and a carving board is positioned on a surface. The room appears to be a rustic kitchen or butchery with stone walls.

artworks.title: V'la une p'tite femme qu'est pas paresseuse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The drawing features two individuals in a theatrical setting. One figure sits down, wearing an elaborate dress and holding an object near their face. The other figure stands, pulling on a rope with tension. The medium appears to be lithographic, with shading and sketchy lines conveying depth and emotion. The scene depicts an interaction characteristic of 19th-century illustrations or caricatures.

artworks.title: Un rappel de chanteuse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures on a stage. One figure is slightly bent at the waist, resembling a bow, while the other is seated or kneeling. The man has dark combed-back hair and a sharply defined face, while the woman has an updo with loose curls framing her face. The man wears a suit with a high-collared shirt, and the woman is in a long gown with ruffles. The woman is holding the man's hand, and there are bouquets of flowers around them on the stage. The background is a drawn curtain, suggesting a theater setting.

artworks.title: L'astronome allemand lachant un ... Canard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old man in a tall, pointed hat and robe, covered in celestial symbols. He is leaning over a wooden cage containing ducks, which is being opened to release a star with a comet-like trail. The star has an anthropomorphic character and determined expression as it exits the cage. The background is lightly sketched with horizontal strokes.

artworks.title: Les inqiétudes du viticulteur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people in a dense vegetation. One person is examining plants that resemble a vineyard while the other is holding two large wooden poles. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for satirical portrayals of social and political situations in 19th-century France. The figures appear to be engaged in agricultural inspection, highlighting themes of labor and agriculture. The medium suggests a humorous or ironic approach to communicating concerns about crop production challenges.

artworks.title: Le bon temps est passé ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of four men standing together. The men are dressed in formal attire, wearing long coats and top hats. They have exaggerated facial features. In the background, there are architectural features suggesting an urban setting. To the right, there is a small building or booth with a barred window. The style is likely a caricature.

artworks.title: Mr. Prudhomme vouant son fils au ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures looking at a sign with money bags labeled 'MILLION'. The tall figure appears surprised or disapproving, while the smaller figure is kneeling in front of the sign. The sign reads "MILLION" above three bags labeled "10000." The drawing may convey a message about wealth idolization.

artworks.title: Ayant eu la vaniteuse idée de vouloir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three human-like figures in a body of water. The image depicts three heads in the water with a train traveling on train tracks in the background. The water is depicted in flowing lines that suggest movement and texture, with the three figures partially submerged. In the distance, a train is shown traveling along a straight horizon line, with steam emerging from its engine. The drawing features a caption at the bottom.

artworks.title: Grand bal a petit orchestre...  (recto); Une société en nom collectif (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a caricature illustration of several people gathered together. The characters have exaggerated facial features and are shown facing each other. On the left, two women and a man are dressed in period clothing with features typical of caricatures. The man wears a top hat and bow tie, and the women wear bonnets or shawls. To the right, a man and a woman also wear formal attire. They seem focused on each other. In the background, there is a small orchestra playing instruments on an elevated platform, with drapery or a curtain around them. The overall setting suggests an outdoor or decorated environment.

artworks.title: Aux bains a quatre sous
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and white sketch of a public swimming bath scene. Various figures are depicted engaging in activities around and in the water. Some are entering the water, with some diving, others swimming, and a few sitting by the edge. Water splashing is shown as people interact with the environment. In the background, there is a seated figure sketching or writing. The individuals' expressions and poses are exaggerated, conveying joy and leisure. Bold lines and shading are used to create depth and highlight the lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Le premier bain
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows two individuals - a man and a child. The man is kneeling in shallow water at the base of a flight of stairs, carrying the child on his shoulders. The child is holding onto the man's head, while the man supports the child with one hand. The man has a muscular build and a grimacing expression, short cropped hair, and is wearing a dark tank top and shorts. The child appears concerned, with curly hair and a dark outfit. The surroundings include steps leading out of the water, draped with nets. In the background, several figures watch from the sidelines. The setting looks like an indoor bathing facility with columns and high ceilings. The image has a sketchy style, suggesting movement and depth.

artworks.title: Prenant le titre ... de Mr de Girardin trop au sérieux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a street scene. A horse-drawn carriage is on the street, driven by a man with two horses harnessed to it. In the background, a building with the words "PRESSE" and "LETTRES D'UN MORT" and a skull and crossbones illustration can be seen. Two men in top hats and long coats are facing the building. The illustration is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Gentlemen en toilette de workhouse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures near a workhouse. The figures seem to be emerging from a carriage next to the building labeled "WORKHOUSE". The artwork features caricature-style figures with exaggerated features. The scene uses strong contrasts and line work to convey a night-time setting. The drawing depicts expressive body language and detailed elements.

artworks.title: Exercises de l'hercule prussien
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a strongman struggling under the weight of multiple loads arranged on his back. The scene is depicted before an audience seated under a large tent. The strongman is on the ground, dressed as a performer with a helmet and is attempting to lift the substantial weight with evident strain. His facial expression and posture convey the challenge of the task. The people in the audience are sketched in a manner that captures their attention and possible amusement, suggesting that this is a moment of public spectacle. The tent and the audience create a backdrop that frames the main focus of the drawing, emphasizing the strongman's efforts. The drawing style is expressive, using character exaggeration to enhance the narrative and humor.

artworks.title: Le Président de la diète
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated at a desk. The man is leaning back in his chair with his head tilted upward, looking above with a wide-eyed expression. He has a round face, a prominent nose, a thick neck, and sparse hair on the top of his head, with side whiskers on either side. His clothing consists of a dark jacket over a buttoned vest, with a necktie visible. His arms rest on the armrests of the chair. On the desk in front of him are papers, a quill pen in an inkwell, a hat, and a bell. Above the man, two swords hang by their tips over his head, labeled "Prusse" (Prussia) and "Autriche" (Austria). The background consists of swirling shaded lines. The text at the bottom of the image reads "Le Président de la diète, ou le double Damoclès!" referring to the man portrayed as the President of the Diet, with a double Sword of Damocles metaphor.

artworks.title: Un inventeur qui craint que son fonds ne luis reste ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricatured figure sitting on a pile of cannonballs with a cannon beside them, while a group of onlookers observe.
